Colorful retro character collage print
Classic black color
Trendy oversized and relaxed fit
Round neck
Short sleeves
Comfortable and lightweight feel
Breathable design for everyday wear

Perfect for casual and streetwear styling

Color: Black
Print: Retro Character Collage
Fit: Oversized / Relaxed Fit
Neck: Round Neck
